title: Sharky - People Are Strange
htmlContent:
Rising UK artist Sharky's "People Are Strange" is a must listen for every music lover out there. She displays excellence from beginning to end. From the sharp lyrics that shows how incredible her pen is, the signature exhilarating flow that brings excitement, and it’s all over a beat that sounds tailor made for her to snap on.
